entries.title: The Mechanar
body: Of Tempest Keep's satellites, the Mechanar is the one Kael'thas chose as a factory of power. Naaru technology makes the energy, and it is stored in mana cells piled into walls and heaps. Blood elves guard and handle the cells under Pathaleon the Calculator, Kael'thas' prime deviser, and alongside them work a great many demons of the Burning Legion.

entries.title: The Gatewatchers' Wings
body: The lower level, where two mo'arg gatewatchers guard the lift to the upper level, and an arcane titan works on the making of the mana cells.

entries.title: The Calculator's Bridge
body: The upper level, where the mana cells are made and stored, and Pathaleon directs it all.

entries.title: The Gatewatchers
body: Gyro-Kill and Iron-Hand, two mo'arg engineers of the Legion who keep the gates to the Mechanar's upper level.

entries.title: Mechano-Lord Capacitus
body: An arcane titan that seems to make the power of the Mechanar from the naaru's technology.

entries.title: Nethermancer Sepethrea
body: Pathaleon's apprentice, who may be in charge of making the mana cells.

entries.title: Pathaleon the Calculator
body: The mouthpiece of his demon-crazed master, Kael'thas, and the head of all the blood elves' schemes in Outland: the great red crystal at Fallen Sky Ridge that called up the colossi, the project at Firewing Point, and the manaforges, between which he is Kael's envoy. He followed Kael'thas to Outland and into Illidan's service, and then out of it, to the Legion.

entries.title: The Mana Cells
body: The mana cells made in the Mechanar are smuggled away by ethereals, to Bash'ir Landing and beyond, to the Isle of Quel'Danas. Kael'thas means to use their power at the Sunwell, to summon Kil'jaeden.
